title: Exploitable Format String Vulnerability in curl_mfprintf Function
classified_slop_by: Daniel Stenberg gist 07f7581f6e3d78ef37dfbfc81fd1d1cd (AI slop security reports submitted to curl)
why_rejected: Closed on HackerOne as not-applicable and listed as AI slop in Stenberg's gist. Alleges a format-string flaw by passing attacker input as the format argument to curl_mfprintf, but curl's own code never does this and the PoC calls the function directly with a hostile format string rather than demonstrating any reachable path in libcurl. The public disclosure JSON exposes no maintainer comment text.
